from solution import loss_amount


def test_issue_loss_basic():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(1500, 1200) == 300  # 1500 - 1200 = 300


def test_issue_profit_returns_none():
    """Returns None if there is no loss."""
    assert loss_amount(1200, 1500) is None  # 1200 < 1500 so no loss -> None


def test_issue_equal_returns_none():
    """Returns None if there is no loss."""
    assert loss_amount(1000, 1000) is None  # 1000 == 1000 so no loss -> None


def test_issue_loss_boundary_one_below():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(100, 99) == 1  # 100 - 99 = 1


def test_issue_profit_boundary_one_above():
    """Returns None if there is no loss."""
    assert loss_amount(99, 100) is None  # 99 < 100 so no loss -> None


def test_issue_large_loss():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(1000000, 250000) == 750000  # 1000000 - 250000 = 750000


def test_issue_zero_sale():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(500, 0) == 500  # 500 - 0 = 500


def test_issue_decimal_loss():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(10.5, 10.0) == 0.5  # 10.5 - 10.0 = 0.5


def test_contract_none_identity():
    """Else return None."""
    result = loss_amount(50, 100)  # 50 < 100 so no loss -> None
    assert result is None


def test_contract_loss_is_cost_minus_sale():
    """Gives loss amount if the given amount has loss."""
    assert loss_amount(200, 150) == 50  # 200 - 150 = 50
